newsitem.title: USA: Unitil/Fitchburg to cut electric bills.
newsitem.headline: Unitil/Fitchburg to cut electric bills.

text.p: Unitil/Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Co said Monday it reduced its electric fuel charge.
Unitil said it got the order approving this decrease on May 1, and will reduce electric bills by up to nine percent.
The electric fuel charge for the next quarter, beginning August 1, is expected to remain about the same as the new, lower rate, Unitil said.
The decrease in the May charge tracks the downturn in fuel costs which began several months ago, following the unforeseen run-up in fuel prices late last fall, the company said.
